description: Project-owned batch registry. Windows Task Scheduler is the primary executor for production batches; OpenClaw cron specs are kept as legacy/fallback metadata. Report delivery channel is NOT set per-job here — it is controlled globally by NOTIFY_CHANNEL in .env (default discord); see etl/scripts/notify.py to switch or add channels. windowsTask.delivery below records the default channel's env only.

defaults.fileReadingRule: Read batch instruction files and Korean report bodies with a platform-neutral UTF-8-safe reader, such as OpenClaw file_fetch or native workspace file access. Do not use host-default shell decoding such as Windows PowerShell 5.1 Get-Content without explicit UTF-8 handling. If Korean text appears corrupted, discard that read result and reread with a UTF-8-safe reader before composing the Discord report.
